Vendored paths (byte-for-byte upstream; SOURCE-MANIFEST.sha256):
  src/hw/ahci.c, ahci.h              AHCI SATA disks and ATAPI drives
  src/hw/ata.c, ata.h                parallel ATA / ATAPI (PIO)
  src/hw/blockcmd.c, blockcmd.h      SCSI command layer shared by the HBAs
  src/hw/virtio-blk.c, virtio-blk.h  virtio block (legacy and 1.0)
  src/hw/virtio-scsi.c, virtio-scsi.h
  src/hw/virtio-pci.c, virtio-pci.h, virtio-ring.c, virtio-ring.h,
    virtio-mmio.c, virtio-mmio.h     virtio transport
  src/hw/lsi-scsi.c, lsi-scsi.h      LSI 53C895A
  src/hw/esp-scsi.c, esp-scsi.h      AMD Am53C974 (PCscsi, Tekram DC-390)
  src/hw/megasas.c, megasas.h        LSI MegaRAID SAS / Dell PERC5
  src/hw/mpt-scsi.c, mpt-scsi.h      LSI Fusion-MPT SAS1068 / 53C1030
  src/hw/pvscsi.c, pvscsi.h          VMware PVSCSI
  src/hw/sdcard.c                    SD Host Controller (SDHCI) and cards
  src/hw/nvme.c, nvme.h, nvme-int.h  NVM Express
  src/hw/floppy.c, dma.c             82077AA floppy controller, 8237 ISA DMA
  src/hw/usb.c, usb.h                USB core and enumeration
  src/hw/usb-xhci.c, usb-xhci.h      xHCI host controllers
  src/hw/usb-ehci.c, usb-ehci.h      EHCI host controllers
  src/hw/usb-uhci.c, usb-uhci.h      UHCI host controllers (see below)
  src/hw/usb-ohci.c, usb-ohci.h      OHCI host controllers
  src/hw/usb-hub.c, usb-hub.h        USB hubs
  src/hw/usb-hid.c, usb-hid.h        USB boot-protocol keyboards and mice
  src/hw/usb-msc.c, usb-msc.h        USB mass storage (bulk-only)
  src/hw/usb-uas.c, usb-uas.h        USB Attached SCSI
  src/hw/ps2port.h
  src/hw/pci.h, pcidevice.h, pic.h, rtc.h
  src/block.h, bregs.h, byteorder.h, list.h, std/bda.h, std/disk.h

Deliberately not vendored: SeaBIOS's POST, int13/int15 handlers, boot
menu, memory manager, threads, output engine and every header that describes
the 16-bit or segmented environment (types.h, farptr.h, biosvar.h, x86.h,
malloc.h, output.h, stacks.h, util.h, string.h, config.h and friends);
ports/seabios/include replaces them. hw/pci_regs.h and hw/pci_ids.h are also
replaced there with the PCI-specification constants the drivers use, because
SeaBIOS's copies came from Linux without a licence notice of their own.

One vendored file is also compiled through an OpenRFS wrapper:
src/hw/usb-uhci.c is built from ports/seabios/lp64/usb-uhci.c, which first
includes ports/seabios/lp64/usb-uhci.h - a copy of src/hw/usb-uhci.h whose
struct uhci_td declares the hardware buffer pointer as u32 instead of
void *. That copy (LGPL-3.0, like its original) is the only modified
SeaBIOS text in OpenRFS; the vendored file itself is unchanged.
